title: Astrocyte Production Protocol
author: Michael S. Fernandopulle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5xag7ie

steps.title: Prepare initial astrocyte culture
steps.instruction: Isolate astrocytes from rat pups and expand them in DMEM with 10 % FBS.

substeps.instruction: Remove meninges completely from brains of 3 P0 or 1 P1 rat pup per uncoated T75 flask.
Isolate astrocytes using standard mechanical and/or enzymatic dissociation protocols under sterile conditions.
Seed the dissociated cells into the T75 flask.
Culture in DMEM containing 10 % FBS by volume for 1 week or until confluent (astrocyte medium).

steps.title: Shake to remove contaminating cells
steps.instruction: Place flasks on a shaker to eliminate microglia, residual neurons, and other contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C until contaminating cell types are removed (duration not specified).

steps.title: Wash and trypsinize near-confluent cells
steps.instruction: Detach near‑confluent astrocytes using PBS wash and a brief trypsin incubation.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Collect the trypsinized cells by centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:05:00 (5 minutes) at room temperature (speed not specified).

steps.title: Resuspend and seed into new flasks
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in DMEM + 10 % FBS and distribute into three fresh T75 flasks.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in DMEM containing 10 % FBS.
Seed cells from each original T75 into three new T75 flasks.
Grow until nearly confluent; astrocytes may be passaged up to two times (more passages reduce support qualities).

steps.title: Freeze astrocytes for storage
steps.instruction: Optionally cryopreserve astrocytes in liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Freeze astrocytes in liquid nitrogen following Basic Protocol 1.

steps.title: Add astrocytes to neural cultures
steps.instruction: Introduce astrocytes to neural cultures by seeding onto a transwell, using fresh or thawed cells.

substeps.instruction: Repeat steps 3‑5 or thaw frozen stock.
Seed cells onto a transwell in the neural culture.
Over‑add astrocytes if needed; if neuron health is poor, add additional astrocytes the following day.
